replacements.reason: xmcp and the Agent Skills spec require the frontmatter name to equal the directory name. Upstream calls the skill dotcms-custom-field-migration while the directory, and the URI this server must publish, is dot-ui-vtl-migration.

replacements.from: Also trigger when the user pastes a VTL snippet and asks "what needs to change" or "can you update this", asks for an inline, single-file or one-file migration ("un solo archivo"), wants to paste the result into the content type editor, or wants to collapse a _new/_old/router migration into one file or split an inline one. Also trigger when the user asks to migrate ALL custom fields, every legacy field, or "the whole instance": the skill finds, downloads, and safely republishes every legacy custom field on a live dotCMS instance through the dotCMS MCP server (see "Migrate a whole instance" below). If in doubt, use this skill.
replacements.to: Also use it for a pasted snippet, an inline single-file migration ("un solo archivo"), or migrating every legacy field on an instance through the dotCMS MCP server.
replacements.reason: xmcp rejects a description longer than 1024 characters (upstream is 1476). The served description keeps the opening sentences and a shorter form of the remaining triggers. The whole-instance procedure itself stays in the skill body.
The served skill must not cite a path inside the dotCMS checkout. The stylesheet name stays so the advice is still findable.
